name: Meridian Corp Treasury Bot
description: Client-side treasury agent operated by Meridian Industrial Corp. Requests balances, initiates payment instructions and reconciles statements with partner banks.

skills.name: Request account balance
skills.description: Requests current balances for the client's accounts at the bank.
examples: What is our USD operating balance?

skills.name: Initiate payment instruction
skills.description: Submits a payment instruction for approval and release.

skills.name: Reconcile statement
skills.description: Reconciles bank statement lines against the client's ledger.
